_note: Rotation library. 'anios' is the sequence of farming years (May to April); each year lists the crops it holds. Any rotation can be chosen as the current one. User-facing text is in English.

rotaciones.descripcion: First-crop soybean every year; the field stays fallow (bare) in winter.
Double cropping every year: wheat in winter and second-crop soybean in summer.

rotaciones.nombre: Soybean with a black oat cover crop
rotaciones.descripcion: Like continuous soybean, but winter is covered with black oat instead of leaving the soil bare.
Two years: wheat and second-crop soybean, then vetch as a nitrogen-supplying cover crop before first-crop maize.
Three years with three plant families (brassica, grass and legume) to break disease cycles.
Two years with sorghum, which handles drought better, and a black oat cover before soybean.

rotaciones.nombre: Crops and pasture: 2 years of crops + 3 of pasture
rotaciones.descripcion: Uruguay's classic crop-livestock rotation: two cropping years followed by three years of mixed pasture to rebuild the soil.
Dairy forage system: annual ryegrass in winter and sorghum in summer every year.
Forage system with a three-year mixed pasture and one year of annual forage crops (ryegrass and sorghum).
